## Clean data

```{r}
###Cleaning data to only show relevant columns###

GHGemissions_countries <- 
  select(World_Bank_Data, 
         REF_AREA_LABEL, 
         TIME_PERIOD, 
         OBS_VALUE) 

head(GHGemissions_countries)
```

```{r}
### Test to check the class of all columns###

class(GHGemissions_countries$OBS_VALUE)

```
